name: Workflow
title: Workflow - Scoped
summary: The scoped Workflow API provides methods that can be used in an activity definition script.
overview: There are no constructors for creating an instance of a scoped workflow object. Instead, use the global workflow object available in activity scripts. This workflow object is available in any script location inside a workflow.

members.name: debug
members.summary: Adds a debug message to the log.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
message String The message to add to the log.
args Object Arguments to add to the message.
Returns
Type Description
String The message added to the log. 
var loggedMessage = workflow.debug("All is well");

members.name: inputs
members.summary: Object that contains the workflow variables.
members.html:
This is not a method, but rather a way to reference the variables in a workflow object, such as the user. Workflow variables are defined in the properties of the workflow or by scripted activities.

Field
Name Type Description
inputs Object Workflow variables as name value pairs. The variables of a workflow object are custom to an integrator's implementation. 
var user = workflow.inputs.u_user;

None

members.name: result
members.summary: Element of the workflow object that contains the workflow results.
members.html:

Field
Name Type Description
result String Workflow results.
